[SWS_DM_00964] Configuration of a DTCs failed Operation Cycles Since Last
Failed as extended data record
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is referred by
Di-
agnosticEdrDataProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticEdrDataProviderMapping.dataProvider
is set to
DEM_CYCLES_SINCE_LAST_FAILED
, the DM shall report the internal value of
the current
Operation Cycles Since Last Failed Counter
of the contextual
DTC in the respective extended data record.
The length of this
internal data element
is one byte.
⌋
